content:
sam: quick heads-up — onboarding sge-13. weights landed in prod bucket but tokenizer is inserting an extra BOS with our chat template, leading to kv-cache offset in streaming tests

rachel: ugh that's annoying. seen similar where special_tokens mapping differs between tokenizer metadata and runtime defaults

sam: minimal repro i used locally: 
```python
>>> tok.encode(\"System: You are an assistant\nUser: hello\")
# got: [101, 5, 234, ...]  # 101 is unexpected BOS id
```

jeff: check model-registry config. if model-config has explicit `special_tokens` missing bos/eos the runtime sometimes injects them for legacy compat

maria: where are the weights exactly? i can run a Dedicated smoke once we sort the token mapping

sam: weights path in registry points to: gs://redwood-models/prod/sge-13-v1/sge-13-v1.safetensors. there was also a tar in the same prefix earlier, but safetensors is the canonical mmap file

jeff: share sha256 so CI can pin artifact — we had CI pick the tar previously and that caused weird shape mismatch

maria: copied checksum: abc123def4567890 (8.9GB). i'll validate artifact in Dedicated at 14:00 UTC

rachel: proposal: add serving flag `chat_strip_specials = ["bos"]` scoped per-model. default false. for sge-13 we enable it. this avoids changing customer prompts/templates

jeff: that sounds reasonable but we must ensure streaming still appends EOS at end. tests need to assert last token == eos_id when streaming closes

sam: agreed. if we strip BOS during tokenization we must also ensure kv-cache indices align for prefix caching (off-by-one will break batcher reuse)

rachel: i'll draft a PR with: 1) model-registry update pointing to safetensors+checksum, 2) serving flag + runtime check, 3) unit test `test_chat_bos_eos_bounds` in tokenization matrix, and 4) update docs on rollout note

rachel: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/802 (includes test and config doc)

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #802 — running token-matrix and perf smoke jobs

jeff: i'll review PR later today. i'll also run a quick batcher sim against the patched runtime to ensure prefix cache still hits expected offsets

maria: if Dedicated smoke shows kv-cache aligned i'll flip the registry flag for sge-13 and run canary on Hosted (small percent) before full rollout
sam: reminder to update migration notes for on-prem customers — templates that assumed implicit bos behaviour may change token counts
rachel: will add migration note + customer-impact doc in the PR description

jeff: one more check: make sure tokenizer vocabulary doesn't have duplicate sentinel ids (we had eos==pad once)
maria: i'll run a vocab sanity script against the safetensors weights before smoke: `scripts/verify_vocab.py --artifact <path>`

sam: thanks team. ping here once smoke finishes, i'll coordinate rollback plan if kv-cache misaligns
rachel: thanks — i'll post CI/status and link jira ENG-ML-492 in the PR
